entry.description: move `SyslogNewLineHandling` out of `RemoteSyslogAppender` to `log4net.Appender`, now that `LocalSyslogAppender` uses it too. Configuration files are unaffected, they bind the value by name, but code naming `RemoteSyslogAppender.SyslogNewLineHandling` has to drop the prefix (implemented by @FreeAndNil)
